column2: AIRKNIF 91026 rung comments for Studio 5000 Logix Designer V32. Tools > Import > Tags and Logic Comments. If Owning Element is blank, comments match by Location (rung number). Otherwise check 'Match all ladder diagram rung comments by rung number only'. Location is the 0-based Logix rung index in printout order (GE _MAIN -> MainRoutine, then COAT_WG).
Each comment starts with the GE printout rung number. Printout rung comments are appended when present. Change the program/routine names below if the Airknife project uses different names.
